title: Review check-ins and faster calendar access
details: Today now stays white with a blue outline so calendar bookings remain visible
The old generic Booking option is now Distance Booking with an editable mileage value starting at 0 miles
Booked reviews and observations can be opened directly from the calendar, while meetings open a simple notes page
Reviews can optionally schedule an editable midpoint check-in with a simple notes form
Evia wellbeing check-in history is shown as reference during a review without Milos writing or inferring the wellbeing statement
Review update messages now fade and are removed automatically
